Our therapies

Complementary care with a gentle, grounded approach.

Each session is centred around you: your comfort, your needs and the time you need to slow down, re-balance & relax. Both treatments treat the whole person.

Reiki

A gentle complementary treatment originating in Japan. During the session, the practitioner places their hands lightly on or just above the clothed body, creating a quiet setting intended to encourage relaxation, feelings of peace, security & wellbeing.

  • It is a natural therapy designed to positively boost your sense of well-being and balance.
  • The practitioner will take you to a place of stillness helping you relax and eliminate stress and worries.
  • Reiki has many health benefits and can contribute to pain relief by the promotion of relaxation.
  • Reiki can also be given remotely as Distance Reiki where you do not need to be physically present.

Reflexology

A complementary therapy based on the principles that certain areas in the feet and hands correspond to specific parts of the body, organ or glands. It is a simple, safe, and highly effective treatment that can help ease feelings of anxiety or stress and reduce symptoms such as pain, nausea and constipation whilst aiding sleep and relaxation.

  • During the treatment very gentle pressure will be applied to points on your feet, toes or hands.
  • This pressure releases tension, supports circulation and brings the whole body back into harmony.
  • Sessions usually last for around 45 minutes but can be tailored around comfort and individual needs.
  • Oncology Reflexology also provided.
